messages:
maya_sales: Heads-up 1: CineSys POC needs a hosted API key for their demo. They want a 21-day TTL, automatic rotation at day 10, IP allowlist 198.18.0.0/16 (their office/vpn), and request-level audit logs with prompt redaction. Also need a simple revoke runbook we can send them. Demo next Tue.

 dylan_se: We can issue a workspace-bound hosted key with those constraints. Ephemeral preferred by CineSys but workspace-scoped makes dashboarding & revoke easier. We can add a pre-demo refresh at T-4h to avoid mid-demo rotation.

 frank_security: Security asks: redact prompt/response, retention 90d ok for this POC, and we need the approval ticket ID before creation. Also require webhook notify to #sales on revoke plus an email to the approver.

 ops_alex: Approval ticket CIN-POC-2026 exists. I'll create the key now. Internal CLI (ops only):

```
redwoodctl keys create \
  --workspace cine-poc \
  --owner maya_sales \
  --name cine-poc-hosted-2460 \
  --ttl 21d \
  --rotate-after 10d \
  --pre-demo-renew 4h \
  --allowlist 198.18.0.0/16 \
  --redact-logs true \
  --audit-retention 90d \
  --notify-webhook https://hooks.redwood.sales/cine/revoke \
  --notify-email cine-approver@redwood.example.com
```

 notifbot: Key created: key_CINE555aaa (expires 2026-05-12T16:00:00Z). Rotation scheduled in 10 days. Pre-demo refresh at 2026-05-08T12:00:00Z. Audit logging enabled (redaction: true). Webhook & email notify configured.

 dylan_se: I'll DM the key to maya securely. Reminder: never paste keys into customer chat. If they test from outside the allowlist it will fail.

 maya_sales: Thanks. Can we get a one-page revoke runbook I can send to the customer? They want to know expected time-to-revoke and steps.

 frank_security: Revoke runbook (one-paragraph for customer): "If CineSys requests access removal or a security issue is found, Redwood will immediately revoke the hosted API key upon request. Revocation invalidates the token instantly; audit entries are recorded and a notification is sent to the named approver and the Redwood sales contact. Typical time-to-revoke is under 2 minutes. To restore access we require a new approval ticket and re-issuance of credentials."

 ops_alex: Added automation: if approval ticket status -> blocked, system auto-revokes and posts reason to #sales. Revoke CLI for ops: `redwoodctl keys revoke key_CINE555aaa --reason "sq_blocker"`.

 maya_sales: Perfect 1. Sharing with CineSys now and will confirm after their smoke test. :thumbsup:
